global.title: Agile Space Industries Expands Leadership Structure to Support Next Phase of Growth
global.summary: DURANGO, Colo., Sept. 28, 2026 – Agile Space Industries today announced that Jason Wright will join the company as President in early October, strengthening Agile’s operational leadership as the company continues its rapid growth as a supplier of in-space chemical propulsion products and services. global.title: Common data for shared detection: a blueprint for space cybersecurity
global.summary: Space systems now underpin a growing share of federal and daily commercial operations, from navigation and communications to intelligence collection and emergency-response data. At the same time, these environments have become more software-defined, cloud-connected and dependent on enterprise-sized identity systems.
